title: Taxat Environment Basis Atlas
basisStatement: Bootstrap inputs are typed, secret handles stay opaque, and ConfigFreeze remains the only lawful post-seal execution basis.

strata.label: BOOTSTRAP INPUTS
strata.summary: Process env, explicit overrides, or local-only handle files before seal.

strata.label: SECRET HANDLES
strata.summary: Opaque refs and metadata only; no raw credential values.

strata.label: FROZEN CONFIG
strata.summary: Manifest-bound execution basis once ConfigFreeze exists.

strata.label: RUNTIME CONSUMERS
strata.summary: API, worker, tooling, browser automation, and native-adjacent callers.

consumers.label: API
consumers.basis_statement: Interactive request handling must switch to ConfigFreeze and manifest-bound secret handles as soon as a run is sealed.
